newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest barley prices fall on good crop outlook.
newsitem.headline: Budapest barley prices fall on good crop outlook.

text.p: Barley futures prices on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) ended mostly limit-down on Friday due to expectations of a good crop, traders said.
"Harvesting has started and the crop looks better than expected," said Mihaly Otvos of OTP Forex.
The Agriculture Ministry has estimated the combined spring and autumn barley crop at 1.22 million tonnes this year compared with 930,000 last year.
Barley prices dropped the daily 400 forints per tonne limit for July, October, December and March while August lost 120 and September fell 300.
Barley settlement prices were between 19,110 for July and 21,400 for March.
Milling wheat futures continued the upward correction started on Thursday after almost three weeks of falls. Short position-squaring also contributed to the price rise, Otvos said.
Milling wheat prices rose 120 to 300 forints for August to May while July was flat at 20,180 forints. In Maize only July traded, rising 150 forints to 21,340.
Total grains turnover on the BCE was a modest 796 lots or 344 million forints, down from Thursday's 930 lots or 393.26 million forints.
Milling wheat futures accounted for the bulk of the turnover in volume terms with 594 lots.
